name: Becoming Incubus
source:
In Becoming Incubus, play as Gaël as he navigates a city full of mysteries. He is a bit of an, pardon my french, asshole. Hated by his peers, struggling to make ends meet, very few people can actually stand the guy.
Yet following a chance encounter, he is stricken by a condition that will slowly make him change. To something better or worse? That is for you to decide.
translation:
在《成为梦魇》中，扮演盖尔，穿越一座充满神秘的城市。他有点像个混蛋，请原谅我的法语。被同龄人讨厌，入不敷出，很少有人能真正忍受这个家伙。
然而一次偶然的机会，让他遭遇了一种让他慢慢改变的状况。为了更好或更坏的事情？这由你决定。
